name: Learning Ability
description: Feynman technique (teaching back simply), rapid concept extraction, analogical reasoning, and retention.

dimensions.name: Feynman Simplification
dimensions.description: Explaining complex technical or philosophical ideas to a novice without hiding behind jargon.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Distills dense academic concept into intuitive, everyday physical metaphor.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Clear explanation with 1-2 minor pieces of un-demystified jargon.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Hides lack of understanding behind complex vocabulary.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Parrots textbook definitions verbatim without real comprehension.

dimensions.name: Spaced Recall & Application
dimensions.description: Recalling previously learned concepts under pressure and applying them to alien scenarios.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Instant transfer of mental model from past lessons to completely new domain.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Recalls core framework after short prompting.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Remembers name of framework but botches practical implementation.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Total amnesia of concepts taught within the last 7 days.
